standards.mechanism: Reusable workflow: workflow_call inputs, same-repository ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml at the caller's commit, calling-job keywords limited to uses/with/needs/if/permissions, the github context of the caller
environment on the called job (the calling job cannot set one); deployment protection rules pass before the job is sent to a runner
Job outputs from GITHUB_OUTPUT, read with needs.<job>.outputs through env
vars context in jobs.<job_id>.if and with; an unset variable reads as an empty string
Job-level concurrency group with cancel-in-progress: false; the queue: single default marked as a shortcut
OIDC subject of a job that references an environment, with immutable owner and repository IDs; a reusable workflow's token carries the caller's claims
AWS IAM web-identity trust: exact StringEquals on aud and sub; environments restricted to deployment branches
Environment with a custom deployment branch policy (README commands, typed -F fields)
Deploy the published digest; roll back by redeploying an earlier release

assumptions: A new script, scripts/deploy-workflow.test.sh, and a floor-guard step that runs it, are not in the story's Touches: they are the test-first proof of criteria 1 to 4 (each changed run: step run as GitHub runs it, docker and trivy stubbed), the pattern 9.1 used for scripts/ci-gates.test.sh. scripts/ci-gates.sh's usage comment and scripts/ci-gates.test.sh's floor-guard arguments follow the two new main-only jobs.
deploy-switched-off sets no job-level permissions, so it has the workflow's contents: read (the story's 'no permissions beyond contents: read'); the test pins both.
The call path's SHA bound is today's 'Check the SHA' step, which runs on both paths (the job's SHA reads inputs.sha for either trigger); the images step checks the five references.
The images step tells the paths apart by github.event_name passed through env (a called workflow sees the caller's push); any event other than workflow_dispatch is treated as a call and checked.
The deploy step and every step from configure-aws-credentials on are byte for byte unchanged (git diff shows no change there); the test pins that the deploy step reads steps.images.outputs.*.
publish's shape check runs after its summary row is written, so the job summary table is unchanged even for a reference that then fails the step.
Criteria 5 and 7 are README text and a human step, with no automated test or break; criterion 5's proof is the security agent's read-back.
